name: Lithium cells and packs
summary: Rechargeable lithium-ion and LiFePO4 cells: 18650s, pouch cells and packs in laptops, tools, vapes, e-bikes and power banks.
uses: Replacing dead packs in tools and e-bikes
identify: Cylinders (an 18650 is 18 × 65 mm) or flat silver pouches, usually wrapped in packs with a small protection board. Li-ion runs 3.0–4.2V per cell (3.6–3.7V nominal); LiFePO4 runs 2.5–3.65V (3.2V nominal). Disposable vapes often hide one cell each.
test: Measure each cell: below about 2.5V a Li-ion cell may be damaged; below 1V treat it as dead. Charge slowly and watch: a cell that gets hot, swells or loses voltage overnight is scrap. Never puncture, short or charge a swollen cell.

decay.note: Cells self-discharge slowly; ones left in devices drain flat and can be ruined within a year or two.
